title: TaskDraftList
description: Schema for LLM-produced task drafts before skill assignment. Contains zero skill information — skills are populated by the assign-skills Python script which produces final TaskPacket objects.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of the overall user request, capturing its goal, scope, and constraints.

tasks.description: An ordered list of TaskDraft objects. No skills field — that is added by the Python assign-skills script.

TaskDraft.description: A single atomic task produced by the LLM during decomposition. Does NOT include skills — skills are assigned later by a Python FlashRank reranking script.

purpose.description: Single sentence describing what this task accomplishes. Must be actionable and self-contained.

context.description: Expanded context for the worker. Includes the relevant subset of the user prompt, background information, and any constraints.

filesToRead.description: Explicit list of file paths the worker must read before starting.

filesToWrite.description: Explicit list of file paths the worker is expected to create or modify.

executionInstructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for the worker. Each step is a discrete, verifiable action.

action.description: What to do in this step. Must be concrete and verifiable.

verification.description: Optional: how to verify this step succeeded.
Top-level verification checks the worker must run against their output before finishing.

expectedOutput.description: Precise description of the deliverable this task produces.
